# Work out this month's pay application, retainage included.

> Free pay application generator for subcontractors and small general contractors: paste your schedule of values, set retainage, and get the contract sum, change orders, retainage, previous certificates and current payment due, plus a line-by-line table and CSV. Private, runs in your browser.

Rolls an application forward to next month: previous takes this period, this period starts at zero, stored stays stored, previous certificates carried exactly.

A hosted pay-app suite (saved jobs, retainage until release, lien waivers, change orders) is in development; not on sale and no price yet.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
